EmailTemplate.subject: Important - Action Required For Data Cleanup
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!User.FirstName},
Due to oversight or duplicate email in our system, your account was not adequately activated when we migrated to the new system. This means you would have had to call us to gain access to your insurance documents. I truly regret the error, which has been corrected. Please expect a "Welcome" email from me, which will provide you a path to set your password in the new system and gain access to the world-class Mexican insurance system by MexInsurance®.
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us at 858-663-6453 or reply to this email.
Thank you.
Respectfully, Charles
